description: Initial measurement after tiered loading + width reductions
Reduce archive page size from 24 to 12
Add fetchPriority=low to archive cards — made LCP worse
Reduce archive card image width from 480px to 320px
Reduce hero mid-quality image from 640px to 480px
Reduce showcase card mid-quality from 480px to 320px
Lower WebP quality 76→65, JPEG 78→68 — no improvement (likely cached)
Remove hero idle upgrade (just 480px) — made LCP worse, mid-tier load is key
content-visibility: auto on archive cards — worse (interferes with lazy loading)
Add mid+idle to archive cards — more requests hurt more than savings
Delay initial archive load by 800ms — no improvement
Reduce carousel 800→640px — within noise, quality tradeoff not worth it
Remove showcase idle upgrade — no improvement
Hero mid 480→320px — upgrade re-triggers LCP with bigger image
Reduce archive card image width from 320px to 240px
Page size 12→8 — more images loaded from eager load-more trigger
Module-scope hero fetch — worse in Vite dev mode
Add Timing-Allow-Origin header to image responses
